name: 54016 · Hudson, WI
findings: ZIP 54016 (Hudson) has 132 nonprofit organizations. 68 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 55 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54016 (Hudson) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 8 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
